# verify rule on both demos before submitting. Build f for demo2 (hlines) and transpose for demo1.
def solve_demo2(i):
    H=len(i);W=len(i[0])
    hlines=[r for r in range(H) if all(c==9 for c in i[r])]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in i for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # specials: cells not in {bg, 9}
    sp=[(r,c,i[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r][c] not in (bg,9)]
    out=[row[:] for row in i]
    def ray(r,c,L,s):
        d=1 if L>r else -1
        rr=r+d
        while rr!=L:
            out[rr][c]=s; rr+=d
        out[L][c]=s
    for r,c,s in sp:
        near=[L for L in hlines if abs(L-r)<=8]
        for L in near:
            ray(r,c,L,s)
            # box ring 3x3 around (L,c), leave center
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    if dr==0 and dc==0: continue
                    rr,cc=L+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=9
    return out
